entries.5d1c238c0102bf42: The Medium-Term Management Plan 2030 (five-year plan), formulated in February 2026, sets as its medium- to long-term management policy, under the management philosophy “Realizing a Prosperous World Through Internet Marketing,” the creation of a “token economy (substitute currency economic sphere)” composed of a point economic sphere and blockchain, and becoming a platform that revitalizes socioeconomic activity. Its key strategies are: expanding the value of its vertically integrated model, which leverages Moppy's media strength to form an end-to-end business model through to D2C; establishing a position in the blockchain sphere centered on Mercury and Bitbank, registered crypto-asset exchange service providers; and achieving discontinuous growth by actively pursuing new businesses and M&A.
